title: Organization Goal Schema
description: Represents an organisation's business architecture goal including domain weighting, coverage aspirations, and tolerances.

organization.description: The organisation this goal applies to.

orgUnit.description: Optional organisational unit this goal is targeted at. Leave null for organisation-wide goals.

domain.description: The business architecture domain targeted by this goal.

weighting.description: Relative importance of this domain, typically between 0.0 and 1.0.

coverageGapTolerance.description: Acceptable gap between target and actual domain coverage (e.g. 0.1 = 10% gap).

maturityTargetDate.description: Date by which the organisation aims to achieve the coverage goal.

createdBy.description: User or system that created this record.
